drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease with MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 73-year-old male admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.85, creatinine 0.82, hemoglobin 13.6, platelets 229, sodium 139, wbc 9.7; vitals dbp 75-79, heart_rate 69-75, map 91-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 121-125, spo2 96-98, temp 36.6-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.8, hemoglobin 13.5, platelets 233, sodium 139, wbc 9.6; vitals dbp 74-79, heart_rate 69-74, map 90-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 118-125, spo2 96-98, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 73-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
